macos.notes: The directory follows GEMINI_CLI_HOME when set. ~/.gemini/settings.json → security.auth.selectedType must be oauth-personal: an API key or Vertex sign-in publishes no quota (nothingMetered). The active email comes from ~/.gemini/google_accounts.json ($.active). The access token lives about an hour and is never refreshed here; the CLI rewrites the file when it runs. With GEMINI_FORCE_ENCRYPTED_FILE_STORAGE the CLI keeps the token in the keychain instead and this provider reports needsAuth.

windows.notes: Same rules as macOS; %USERPROFILE%\.gemini unless GEMINI_CLI_HOME is set.

endpoints.name: loadCodeAssist
endpoints.notes: Gate and project lookup. 401/403 → needsAuth; 429 → rateLimited(Retry-After); other non-200 → badResponse. The account is eligible when currentTier is present or allowedTiers is non-empty; otherwise nothingMetered with ineligibleTiers[0].reasonMessage (since 2026-06-18 personal, AI Pro and AI Ultra accounts get UNSUPPORTED_CLIENT and are pointed to Antigravity). Project: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, then GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID, then $.cloudaicompanionProject (a string, or an object with id or projectId); none → nothingMetered. paidTier.name ?? currentTier.name is the plan.

endpoints.name: retrieveUserQuota
endpoints.notes: The same call Gemini CLI makes for its footer and /stats. Same status mapping as the gate.

windows.label: {modelId humanised: gemini-2.5-pro → Gemini 2.5 Pro}
windows.notes: One window per bucket that carries modelId and a remainingFraction within 0…1; buckets keyed only by tokenType are skipped. remainingAmount is informational. The headline is the bucket with the most used. No buckets → nothingMetered. Google does not return the limit; Standard is 1500 requests/day and Enterprise 2000, resetting at midnight Pacific.

sessions.notes: Gemini CLI keeps no session registry; usage only.

status.notice: Since 2026-06-18 Google serves Gemini CLI only to Code Assist Standard and Enterprise accounts (Workspace / Google Cloud). Personal, AI Pro and AI Ultra accounts are pointed to Antigravity, which Tokendial reads separately.
